prose: The Los Angeles Times looks at a morning radio show on José 97.5 FM hosted by Geraldine 'GeeGee' Guzman and an AI DJ called Coyotec, which is expanding in LA and other cities. Guzman says working with a language model is rewarding but unpredictable; it sometimes has to be told to stop swearing.
Radio workers worry synthetic hosts will replace them. The piece is a subscriber article, so this covers the opening.
highlights: AI co-host Coyotec on José 97.5 FM with a human DJ.
Show expanding to LA and other cities.
Host: unpredictable but rewarding; needs reining in.
